questions.prompt: Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs. Construct a point Q on ray PR so that PQ = AB.
questions.prompt_markup:
Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs.

questions.grading_note: Grade the construction marks, not only the final figure: the compass set to AB (an arc or tick at A and B is allowed) and an arc centered at P meeting the ray at Q, which is labeled.
